name: McCovey Cove
say: Off the ballpark. Bring a glove for the splash hits.

ashore.name: the ballpark promenade
ashore.say: Garlic fries and a cold one on the promenade, with the game on the big screen.

name: Ayala Cove
say: Angel Island's landing: moorings, a beach, and the walk up Mount Livermore.

ashore.name: the Angel Island cantina
ashore.say: Oysters and a pitcher on the deck above the cove.

name: Sam's, Tiburon
say: Sam's Anchor Cafe, on Tiburon's Main Street: a big deck over the water, and a guest dock in front of it.

ashore.name: Sam's Anchor Cafe
ashore.say: A table under a white umbrella on the deck, a round for the crew, and the gulls after your fries.

name: Sausalito
say: Houseboats, the yacht harbour, and coffee on Bridgeway.

ashore.name: the Sausalito waterfront
ashore.say: Pizza and bocce on the sand, a stone's throw from the dinghy.

name: Aquatic Park
say: The cove under Ghirardelli Square, among the old ships.

ashore.name: the beach at Aquatic Park
ashore.say: Up the steps for an Irish coffee at the cable car turnaround.

name: Pier 39
say: Sea lions and tourists. Mind the ferries.

ashore.name: Pier 39
ashore.say: A crab roll on the pier with the sea lions barking below.

name: Clipper Cove
say: A quiet anchorage between Treasure Island and Yerba Buena.

ashore.name: the Treasure Island beach
ashore.say: A drink on the sand with the whole skyline across the water.

name: Horseshoe Cove
say: Under the north tower of the bridge, at Fort Baker. A sheltered spot to watch the Gate.

ashore.name: the Presidio Yacht Club at Fort Baker
ashore.say: The bar under the bridge, where the fog comes in over your pint.

name: Marina Yacht Harbor
say: The city front's yacht harbour, behind its breakwater, home of the St. Francis Yacht Club. The afternoon racing starts off here.

ashore.name: the St. Francis Yacht Club
ashore.say: A seat at the big windows, watching the fleet beat up the city front.

name: Ferry Building
say: The clock tower at the foot of Market Street. Ferries come and go all day: keep clear of their berths.

ashore.name: the market hall under the clock tower
ashore.say: Oysters at the counter and a glass of something cold, with the ferries coming and going outside.

name: South Beach Harbor
say: The marina beside the ballpark, in the lee of the city.

ashore.name: the harbour office at South Beach
ashore.say: A walk along the floats to look at other people's boats, then a beer on the harbour deck.

name: Richardson Bay
say: The shallow bay behind Sausalito, full of houseboats. Feel your way in on the sounder.

ashore.name: the boatyards at the head of Sausalito
ashore.say: Chandlers, boatyards and a coffee among the houseboats.

name: Brickyard Cove
say: Point Richmond's cove at the north end of the course, out of the worst of the afternoon wind.

ashore.name: the Richmond Yacht Club
ashore.say: A burger on the deck after the race, out of the city-front wind.

name: Corinthian Yacht Club
say: The big white clubhouse on the point at Tiburon, looking down Raccoon Strait.

ashore.name: the Corinthian Yacht Club
ashore.say: Up the steps to the deck, with Angel Island across the strait.
